summary: The diff implements Date.prototype.setUTCMinutes in its own file, following the 13 spec steps in order. Observable steps run in spec order: this check and slot check, then ToNumber(minute), ToNumber(second) and ToNumber(millisecond) only when those arguments are present (by argument count, not by undefined value). The NaN early return at step 7 happens after the conversions. Steps 8 and 9 default the second and millisecond from tv. Steps 10 to 13 are MakeDate, TimeClip, set [[DateValue]], and return. Errors propagate with `?`. There are no special-cased inputs, no fallback values, and no swallowed errors. The only other changes are renaming the unused new_target parameter and dropping the trailing NOTE/length comment block from the stub. Neither affects behaviour.
notes_for_next_attempt: Nothing blocking. Optional cleanups: the early let-else TypeError at step 1 duplicates the check inside date::this_time_value (same error type, so harmless but redundant). The stub's trailing NOTE and length comment block was removed; restoring it would keep the file closer to the stub. The date helpers in support::date are not in the diff, so their correctness rests on the existing code and the passing test262 runs.
